title: Piyo language
extract: Piyo is a Loloish language of China. The people are ethnic Hani, and the "Bi-Ka" varieties are traditionally considered dialects of Hani. However, in the classifications of Bradley (2007) and Lama (2012), they are more distinct from Hani than other related languages are. Lama classifies Mpi as closer to Biyo dialect than Kaduo is.
